code='''def transform(grid):
    def rotate_cw(matrix):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*matrix[::-1])]
    clockwise = rotate_cw(grid)
    half_turn = rotate_cw(clockwise)
    counterclockwise = rotate_cw(half_turn)
    n = len(grid)
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
path.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
print(ns['transform'](demo)==demo_out)
answer=ns['transform'](test)
print(answer)
